subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 1 – Lesson 6: Culture and Project – Sports and hobbies around the world
outcomes: I can name popular sports in New Zealand, Oman and Canada.
I can compare free-time activities in Oman with other countries.
I can write sentences about free-time activities in Oman.

tf.s: Rugby is popular in New Zealand.
tf.why: Yes! Children there play Rippa Rugby.

tf.s: To go snorkelling, you need to be good at swimming.
tf.why: Correct! Snorkelling is in the water.

tf.s: In cross-country skiing, you can ski uphill too.
tf.why: Right! That's different from downhill skiing.

tf.s: People go windsurfing when there is no wind.
Cross-country skiing is popular in Oman.
tf.why: Cross-country skiing is popular in Canada.

tf.s: Rugby and cross-country skiing are both popular in Oman.
tf.why: Rugby is popular in New Zealand and cross-country skiing in Canada.

tf.s: People go windsurfing at Oman's beautiful beaches.
tf.why: Correct! Oman's beaches are great for windsurfing.
Dangerous means it can hurt you, so be careful.
Yes! A popular activity is liked by many people.

tf.s: A good project page tells when, where and what people have to do.
tf.why: Great! These three details help readers.

boxes.q: Which sport is popular in New Zealand?
To go snorkelling, you need to be good at ___.
Where do people go windsurfing in Oman?
It can be ___, so only go with your family.
boxes.why: Dangerous means we must be careful.

boxes.q: What do you give other groups after their presentation?
boxes.why: Two stars and a wish is kind feedback.

hunt.q: Sport on water with a sail

mcq.q: Which country is famous for Rippa Rugby?
mcq.why: Children in New Zealand play Rippa Rugby.

mcq.q: What do you need to be good at to go snorkelling?
How is cross-country skiing different from downhill skiing?
o: You play it in a team.

mcq.q: Which sentence uses the project language?
o: In Oman, hiking is very popular.
In Oman, hiking is very snowy.
In Oman, hiking is very uphill.
In Oman, hiking is very wheels.

mcq.q: Which sentence about an activity in Oman makes sense?
o: People go hiking in the mountains.
People go skiing in the desert.
People go snorkelling in the mountains.

mcq.q: Which is a good safety sentence?
o: It can be dangerous, so only go with your family.
It's popular, so it's never dangerous.
It's windy, so don't tell anyone.
mcq.why: Going with family keeps you safe.

mcq.q: Which three things should each mini-book page tell readers?
o: when, where and what people have to do
the price, the shop and the colour
the weather, the time and the day

mcq.q: How are rugby and cross-country skiing the same?
o: They are both popular in Oman.

mcq.q: Which sentence correctly compares Oman and Canada?
o: In Oman people go snorkelling, but in Canada people go cross-country skiing.
In Oman people go cross-country skiing, but in Canada people go snorkelling.
In Canada people play Rippa Rugby, but in Oman people ski.
In Oman and Canada people only go skiing.
mcq.why: Snorkelling is in Oman; cross-country skiing is in Canada.

mcq.q: Why should you point to the pictures when you present?
o: to help listeners understand and follow
